title: Brand Manager
description:
Brand Manager

Location: Leeds (Hybrid Working - 3 days office, 2 days home)
Salary: Up to 50,000 Basic + Company Benefits

Our client is a fast-growing consumer brand with a strong presence across retail, e-commerce, and digital channels. Known for innovation, creativity, and customer-centric product development, they are looking to appoint an experienced Brand Manager to drive brand growth.

As Brand Manager, you will take ownership of the brand strategy, ensuring consistent messaging and execution across all consumer touchpoints. Reporting into Marketing Director you will be responsible for delivering brand campaigns, managing product launches, and leading one direct report.

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded marketing professional with previous brand management experience within consumer products, beauty, FMCG, or retail sectors.

Key Responsibilities:
- Develop and execute brand strategies to drive awareness, engagement, and revenue growth.
- Lead the planning and delivery of integrated marketing campaigns across digital, social, retail, and PR channels.
- Manage the full product launch lifecycle, from concept through to market execution.
- Analyse market trends, competitor activity, and consumer insights to identify growth opportunities.
- Work closely with sales, product development, and external agency partners.
- Monitor campaign performance and ROI, providing recommendations for continuous improvement.
- Manage and mentor one direct report, supporting their development and performance.
- Ensure brand consistency across all customer touchpoints.
- Oversee marketing budgets and campaign spend.

Skills Required:
- Must have proven experience working in a similar Brand Manager or Product Marketing/Consumer Marketing role
- Previous experience working within a consumer, FMCG, or personal care sector is essential
- Experience managing and developing at least one direct report
- Strong understanding of brand strategy, campaign management, and consumer marketing
- Commercially aware with the ability to analyse data and translate insights into action
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
- Experience managing agencies and external partners
- Degree-qualified in Marketing, Business, or a related discipline preferred

title: Senior Digital Media Officer
company: West Yorkshire Combined Authority - Agency - Permanent
description:
Senior Digital Media Officer
£47,025 per annum - Grade 8
Leeds / Hybrid
Full time / Permanent - 37 hours per week

Please note that the Combined Authority will consider requests for part-time working and/or job share.

We currently have a vacancy for a Senior Digital Media Officer to join our Digital Media team.

We re looking for a creative, quick-thinking digital communicator to help shape our content for the Mayor of West Yorkshire and the Combined Authority. You will lead on fast-turnaround video, photography and copy for the mayor s channels, keep our content calendar sharp, and help us move from broadcasting to genuine conversation with the people of West Yorkshire.

It s a great time to be working with a mayor. With the national government committed to deepening devolution to English regions, there are more opportunities than ever for the mayor s voice to be heard, locally and nationally. As Senior Digital Media Officer, you will help us spot those moments and turn them into content that lands, while leading our push into new formats and platforms, from short-form video and podcasts to working with creators and influencers, so we reach the audiences that matter where they already are.

Our Offer
- Work your way From flexible and agile working options, including a generous flexi-time scheme to help you balance your personal life and career.
- Time to recharge Enjoy 28 days of annual leave (with increases based on length of service), plus all Bank Holidays.
- Free greener travel across West Yorkshire Cover your commute sustainably with unlimited free bus and rail travel using the MCard (Zones 1 5).
- Secure your future Benefit from a highly competitive Local Government Pension Scheme.
- Investing in you Take advantage of supported funded professional development, regular training, and up to 3 paid volunteering days per year.
- Grow with us Incremental salary progression for most roles and annual cost of living increases.
- Family first We offer enhanced parental and bereavement leave, plus other family-friendly policies to support you when it matters most.
- Your wellbeing, our priority Access 24/7 free confidential counselling services and the Headspace app for you and up to 5 family or friends.
- Modern workspace in a prime location Work in bright, contemporary offices just a 2-minute walk from Leeds Train Station, fully equipped with the latest tech.

The Role

Reporting into the Digital & Social Media Manager, your key responsibilities will include:
- Creation of standout, fast-turnaround content for the mayor s social media channels: planning, shooting and editing in-house video and photography that captures the moment and gets people talking, backed by sharp copy written at pace.
- Bringing fresh ideas to new formats and emerging platforms, from short-form video and podcasts to collaborations with creators and influencers and turning complex policy into content people want to watch, read and share.
- Delivering the content calendar and using performance data to learn what lands, then refining how we create content and helping the mayor build real two-way conversations online rather than simply broadcasting.

Please review the Role Profile on our website for more information about the responsibilities.

About You

You will have the following key skills, attributes, education and experience:
- Extensive knowledge and expertise of the UK Bus, Rail or Tram industry, including bus/crew scheduling and network planning.
- Detailed understanding of local transport policy issues, including current legal/financial regime in which local Public Transport is delivered. Good understanding of public policy issues including processes by which policy changes.
- Experience of managing people including appraisals, performance management, disciplinary, recruitment and selection.
- Ability to design and plan Bus Services to meet organisational and/or customer needs.
- Ability to estimate costs and resource requirements for new and amended Bus Services.

To Apply

If this sounds like your next role, please complete the application form and tell us within the supporting statement why you would be a great fit for our role and how your skills, knowledge and experience align with the requirements within the Role Profile. Please visit our Advice for Candidates webpage and review the guidance on this page for support in completing your application form.

Further Information

The Combined Authority is passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. We know through experience that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better outcomes. We welcome applications irrespective of people's age, disability, neuro-divergence, sex, gender identity and gender expression, race or ethnicity, religion or belief, sexual orientation, pregnancy or maternity, or other personal circumstances. We have policies and procedures in place to ensure that all applicants are treated fairly and consistently at every stage of the recruitment process, including the consideration of reasonable adjustments for people who have a disability and/or who are neuro divergent. To find out more about inclusivity at the West Yorkshire Combined Authority please visit our dedicated webpage.

Under the Disability Confident Scheme, applicants with a disability are guaranteed an interview, subject to the minimum criteria being met.

title: Campaign delivery analyst
description:
Campaign delivery analyst

Bristol or Halifax - hybrid 2 days per week

6 month contract

Inside ir 35

Department: Data and Analytics Delivery
Platform: Customer Communications Business Area: Chief Digital Office

Role Purpose

The Campaign delivery Analyst supports the delivery of data-driven, personalised customer communications that strengthen customer relationships and increase customer and organisational value. Working within a cross-functional team, the role focuses on campaign delivery, customer data analysis and continuous improvement across direct mail (DM), email and SMS channels.

Key Responsibilities
- Campaign Delivery: Support the planning, implementation and execution of customer campaigns using existing tools, including Teradata Customer Interaction Manager (CIM), in line with the organisation's contact strategy.
- Data Analysis and Personalisation: Use SQL or similar coding languages to work with customer data, identify targeting opportunities and deliver more relevant, personalised customer interactions through preferred channels.
- Continuous Improvement: Enhance campaign processes, techniques and the interaction portfolio to improve customer experience, operational efficiency and risk management.
- Platform Transformation: Support the transition to new campaign delivery platforms, processes and operating models while maintaining effective campaign delivery.
- Planning and Organisation: Manage workloads, maintain detailed delivery plans, coordinate campaign activities and ensure projects are completed accurately and on time.
- Stakeholder Collaboration: Work effectively across teams, communicate requirements clearly and identify opportunities to improve business outcomes.

Essential Skills and Experience
- Understanding of campaign management principles and processes.
- Experience using SQL or a similar coding language.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Excellent planning, organisation and time-management capabilities.
- Ability to work collaboratively within a large team and independently when required.
- Effective workload management and a commitment to timely delivery.

Desirable Skills and Attributes
- Experience working with large customer datasets.
- Customer-focused, impact-driven and motivated to improve customer outcomes.
- Proactive in identifying issues, opportunities and process improvements.
- Strong stakeholder engagement, influencing and requirements-gathering skills.
- Adaptability when working with evolving technologies, processes and operating models.

Expected Outcomes
- Timely and accurate delivery of customer communications campaigns.
- Improved customer targeting, personalisation and channel relevance.
- More efficient campaign processes and reduced operational risk.
- Effective support for campaign platform and operating model transitions.
- Strong stakeholder relationships and measurable improvements in customer and business value.

Candidate Profile: An analytical, organised and proactive individual who combines technical capability, campaign management understanding and stakeholder collaboration to deliver effective, personalised customer communications.

TO APPLY - PLEASE APPLY WITH AN UP-TO-DATE CV

Candidates will ideally show evidence of the above in their CV in order to be considered.

Please be advised if you haven't heard from us within 48 hours then unfortunately your application has not been successful on this occasion, we may however keep your details on file for any suitable future vacancies and contact you accordingly.

We respect and appreciate people of all ethnicities, generations, religious beliefs, sexual orientations, gender identities, and more. title: Content & Social Media Executive
description:
Turn live construction projects into engaging digital content. Bring your photography, video and editing skills to Regiis Ceramics and help showcase our work across social media and the web.

Content & Social Media Executive

Regiis Ceramics
Location: Leeds office, with travel to sites nationally
- Salary: £28,000-£32,000 per year, depending on experience
- Full-time, Monday to Friday
- Company electric vehicle provided

About Us

Regiis Ceramics is a commercial tiling contractor working for main contractors across the leisure, retail, hospitality, automotive and healthcare sectors.

We are growing fast and want our work seen. We're looking for a creative, organised Content & Social Media Executive to capture our projects and keep our digital channels active, consistent and engaging.

About the Role

Based at our Leeds office, you will travel to live sites and completed projects nationally, capturing photography, video, reels and drone footage that showcase our work.

You will manage our digital channels and work closely with our external marketing agency to keep content on brand and published on time.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Manage our website, Google Business Profile, LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram, posting social content five days a week in line with our house format and brand guidelines.
- Visit live sites and completed projects nationally to capture photos, videos, reels and drone footage, then edit content for each channel.
- Update the website with project case studies, photos, news and recruitment pages, and support recruitment adverts.
- Keep our Google Business Profile active with weekly project photos, updates and posts, and respond to reviews and Q&As.
- Work with our external marketing agency, supplying site content and project details, coordinating the content calendar and ensuring everything is published on brand and on time.
- Build and manage a content library for every job.
- Track engagement, enquiries, website traffic and Google profile views, providing monthly reports.

About You

You will be a confident content creator with an essential portfolio of photography and video work. Organised and proactive, you will be comfortable managing your own time and working independently.

You will also bring:
- Confidence using editing tools such as CapCut, Premiere, Lightroom or similar.
- Experience updating websites.
- A full UK driving licence.
- A CSCS card, or willingness to obtain one with our support.
- Confidence working on active construction sites while wearing PPE.

Basic SEO knowledge would be an advantage.

What We Offer
- A salary of £28,000-£32,000, depending on experience.
- A company electric vehicle.
- Support to obtain a CSCS card if required.
- The opportunity to showcase varied commercial projects across the country.

How to apply

If you have the skills and experience required for this Content & Social Media Executive position based in Leeds, click "apply" today and check your inbox for an email providing more information on how to tailor your application and provide a cover letter or any supporting documents.

No agencies please.

Other suitable skills and experience include: Content Creator, Social Media Executive, Digital Content Executive, Content Marketing Executive, Social Media Coordinator, Digital Marketing Executive, Videographer, Photographer, Video Editor, Marketing Executive.

title: Content Writer
description:
Role: Content Writer - Leeds

Salary: £27k- £30k DOE per annum

WorkingHours: Monday to Friday 9am-5pm

Benefits:
- Flexible working offered
- Hybrid working offered
- Pension
- 20 days holidays + stats
- Onsite parking
- Free tea and coffee
- Progression opportunities

We're working with a well-established, design-led interiors brand based in Leeds who are on the lookout for a Content Writer.

This fast-paced role is ideal for a wordsmith, someone who can write with clarity and incisiveness, and that can create stunning copy for all audiences, while maintaining a house style and consistent tone of voice.

Working alongside both our internal and external stakeholders, your primary responsibility will be using this writing ability to create compelling and eye-catching product listings on our website. This includes researching and writing informative, persuasive and engaging descriptions that provides customers with all they need to know to make a purchase, as well as creating and adding imagery and videos that truly showcases the products. You will also need to have the ability to turn complicated and technical information into simple copy for all to understand.

Additionally, will also be managing existing and older products to keep information fresh and up-to-date, ensuring that the latest information is always provided, and helping to mitigate customer service issues.

You will also support our wider marketing team with creation of new brand and product categories, writing SEO-optimised content to assist with our overall digital marketing strategy.

This role also provides long-term opportunities to assist across multiple channels and platforms, including creating guides, videos, and social media content for our in-house magazine and customer buying guides, as well as support the wider marketing team by generating copy for other channels such as email marketing. Any demonstrable experience and skills in these areas would be hugely beneficial for the successful candidate.

The Role
- Listing and addition of new products to the website using our bespoke in-house CMS
- Writing engaging and exciting product copy to accompany products being listed
- Editing and creation of any supplier-provided or in-house imagery, visual assets and videos
- Updating and checking of stock availability on products alongside our sales team
- Liaising with external stakeholders and brands to obtain any missing product information, required assets, or to clarify any information
- Managing existing products to ensure they are up-to-date with updated copy, and that any new information or product changes are added from new brochures
- Price checking and management, updating any price increases or decreases
- Creation of product and brand categories using SEO best practise, alongside optimised written copy
- Writing and creation of content for our blog/magazine in terms of guides, videos, and visual assets
- Ability to support with ongoing sales and marketing campaigns in terms of email marketing, social media and more.

Essential skills & Attributes
- Excellent written communication skills including grammar, punctuation and syntax
- Strong verbal skills to communicate with both internal and external stakeholders
- Excellent proofreading skills and ability to check own work, since you will be listing products independently
- Time management and efficiency as you will need to upload products at pace
- Knowledge of Content Management Systems / basic content uploading skills
- Fast-learner since you will need to get to grips with product & technical information quickly
- An eye for detail, since you will be observing any changes and making corrections/adding changed information
- Knowledge of Microsoft suite of software (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc)
- Excellent organisational skills to be able to plan and manage own workload
- Some knowledge of Search Engine Optimisation (SEO) and keyword research would be ideal, since you will be writing content that is optimised/maintains SEO best practise.

Desirable:
- Knowledge of bathroom/interior design/home improvement products, trends and styles
- Use of SEO and keyword research tools such as Semrush
- Experience of using Adobe software (Photoshop, InDesign, Fireworks, Premiere etc) or equivalent creative tools

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing Executive

Salary: £30,000 - £33,000, depending on experience

Location: Leeds (LS7), with occasional travel across Yorkshire - full driving license and access to a car

Full-time, Permanent, On-site (4 days a week, remote x 1 day a week)

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced, creative, organised and hands-on Marketing Executive to join the team. Working alongside our Senior Marketing Manager, you'll turn our marketing plans into the content, campaigns and stories that people across Yorkshire see every day.

Every week there are amazing things happening for children in our region, and your job is to capture them and share them, on social media, in emails, on our website, in the press and at our events. If the Senior Marketing Manager sets the direction, you're the person who makes it happen and keeps it moving.

Maybe you're a couple of years into your marketing career and ready for a role where you can see the difference your work makes. Maybe you're simply ready to put your skills towards something with purpose. Either way, we need someone experienced, who loves creating content, is happy implementing and supporting planning, and takes pride in getting the detail right.

Key responsibilities but not limited to:-

Content and social media
- Create, schedule and publish day-to-day content across our social channels, including Meta (Facebook and Instagram), LinkedIn, YouTube.
- Manage our social communities: respond to comments and messages, and spot stories and opportunities worth sharing.
- Capture photos, short videos and stories from our programmes and events, following our safeguarding and consent procedures for children and families.
- Write engaging copy for social posts, the website, newsletters and printed materials, in the charity's tone of voice.

Campaigns, email and website
- Support the planning and delivery of integrated campaigns, coordinating content and assets across digital, print, PR and events.
- Build, test and send email campaigns in Mailchimp, and help grow and keep our supporter lists tidy.
- Keep the website up to date with news, events, case studies and campaign pages.
- Help the agencies we work with by preparing briefs, assets and approvals on time.

Events and fundraising support
- Promote our events calendar through pre-event marketing, live on-the-day content and post-event follow-up.
- Work closely with the fundraising and programme teams so marketing supports their goals.
- PR and storytelling
- Gather case studies and draft news stories and press releases for the Senior Marketing Manager and our PR agency.
- Maintain our photo and video library and the consent records that go with it.

Brand and materials
- Produce on-brand digital and print materials (posters, leaflets, presentations, event signage) using Canva or Adobe tools.
- Brief and liaise with suppliers such as printers and photographers.

Planning, data and reporting
- Keep our content calendar and projects up to date in Trello and Monday CRM.
- Pull together monthly performance reports across social, email and web to feed into the Senior Marketing Manager's ROI reporting and suggest what we could do better.

About you
- You live in Yorkshire (commutable to LS7).
- You have a full driving license and access to a car.
- You have a minimum of 2-3 years' marketing experience, in a charity, an agency or the commercial sector.
- You write well, with clear, warm and accurate copy, and you pay close attention to detail.
- You're confident creating content for social media and know how each platform works.
- You've used Mailchimp (or a similar email platform) and design tools such as Canva or Adobe.
- You're organised and can juggle several projects and deadlines at once.
- You're outgoing, and a team player.

Desirables
- Experience in the charity, children's or community sector.
- Short-form video filming and editing skills (e.g. CapCut, Premiere Pro).
- Experience updating a website CMS such as WordPress.
- An understanding of safeguarding and consent when using images of children.
- Some experience of paid social (e.g. Meta Ads Manager).

Additional information

Given the nature of our work with children and young people, this role is subject to a satisfactory DBS check.

How to apply

If you feel you have the skills and experience for this role, please send your CV and a short cover letter telling us why you'd be a great fit and what you'd bring to the team.

Equals One is an advertising and recruitment agency working on behalf of our client to promote this vacancy. You may be contacted directly by the employer should they wish to progress your application. Due to the number of applications we receive, we are unable to provide specific feedback if your application is unsuccessful.

title: Office Administrator/Marketing Coordinator

- Assist with growing brand awareness and engagement with potential clients and industry contacts.

- Previous experience in an administrative or office support role.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint.
- Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and prioritise deadlines.
- Confident working independently and supporting senior management.
- A proactive, flexible and positive approach to work.
- Professional and confident when communicating with clients, suppliers and colleagues.

Desirable:
- Experience supporting an accounts or finance department.
- Experience managing staff training records, compliance documentation or accreditations.
- Familiarity with B2 B tender portals and tender submission processes.
- Experience creating business presentations and marketing materials.
- Knowledge of LinkedIn company page management and content creation.
- Experience using Canva or other design software.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured against:
- Office Administration: Efficient completion of administrative tasks and accurate record keeping.
- Accounts Support: Timely processing of paperwork and effective assistance to the accounts team.
- Training Compliance: Training matrix kept current, with refresher training booked ahead of expiry dates.
- Accreditations: 100% of required company accreditations maintained and renewed before expiry.
- Tender Support: Relevant B2 B opportunities regularly identified, tracked and supported within submission deadlines.
- Marketing Materials: High-quality, professional client presentations and business development documentation produced on time.
- LinkedIn Activity: A minimum of one relevant, professional LinkedIn post published each week.

Personal Attributes

We are looking for someone who is:
- Highly organised and detail oriented.
- Self-motivated, reliable and able to take ownership of responsibilities.
- Creative and confident in producing professional marketing content.
- Comfortable working directly with company directors.
- Able to manage competing priorities in a busy office environment.
- Keen to learn, develop new skills and contribute to the growth of the business.

What We Offer

- The opportunity to work closely with the directors and contribute to business growth.
- Opportunities for professional development and additional training.
- A supportive and collaborative working environment.
- The opportunity to take ownership of key administrative, compliance and marketing activities.

Overall Objective

To provide reliable and proactive administrative support across the business, ensuring
office operations run efficiently, training and accreditations remain compliant, and the
directors are effectively supported with tender opportunities, client presentations and
marketing activities.

title: PPC Manager

Google Ads Microsoft Ads Lead Generation Performance Marketing

The Opportunity

We're working with a growing, performance-driven acquisition business specialising in generating high-intent consumer leads across multiple legal claims sectors. Operating in a regulated environment, the business combines data-led decision-making, creative testing and paid media expertise to deliver efficient, scalable customer acquisition. As the business continues to grow, it is expanding its client portfolio, entering new market verticals and strengthening its in-house paid media function. Google and Microsoft Ads are central to this growth, creating an exciting opportunity for a commercially minded PPC Manager to take ownership of campaign performance and help shape the next stage of the business's acquisition strategy.

The Role

As PPC Manager, you'll manage and optimise paid search campaigns across Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising, with a focus on delivering efficient cost per lead (CPL) and cost per acquisition (CPA).

You'll work across Search, Performance Max and Demand Gen campaigns, using data, structured testing and continuous optimisation to improve performance and identify opportunities to scale.

Working closely with creative, compliance, data and implementation teams, you'll ensure campaigns are not only commercially effective but also compliant with relevant advertising regulations, platform policies and internal standards.

With exposure to multiple legal claims verticals and audiences, this is an opportunity to develop your expertise across a varied portfolio of performance marketing campaigns while making a direct contribution to business growth.

Key Responsibilities
- Plan, execute and optimise paid media campaigns across Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising, driving efficient lead generation and acquisition.
- Audit and evaluate multiple advertising accounts, identifying opportunities to improve performance, efficiency and scalability.
- Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, keywords, bidding, ad copy and creative assets.
- Manage Search, Performance Max and Demand Gen campaigns, including image- and video-led advertising formats.
- Analyse campaign performance using platform data, conversion metrics and internal business intelligence to inform optimisation decisions.
- Use downstream lead quality and disposition data, where available, to improve acquisition efficiency and campaign outcomes.
- Maintain well-organised, scalable account structures, including consistent naming conventions, tracking and account hygiene.
- Collaborate with creative teams to develop and test effective advertising copy and visual assets.
- Work closely with compliance stakeholders to ensure campaigns meet applicable legal, regulatory and platform requirements.
- Produce clear weekly and monthly performance reports, highlighting trends, risks, opportunities and actionable recommendations.
- Ensure optimisation decisions are commercially justified and aligned with agreed KPIs.
- Support the launch of new accounts, campaigns and claims verticals as the business expands.

About You

You're a data-driven PPC professional who enjoys taking ownership of campaign performance, identifying opportunities and turning insights into measurable results.

You'll ideally bring:
- At least two years' experience managing Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising campaigns.
- Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads, ideally within lead generation, direct response or another performance-focused environment.
- Experience managing campaigns against CPL, CPA or similar acquisition targets.
- A solid understanding of campaign testing, optimisation, scaling and performance analysis.
- Experience with Performance Max and Demand Gen, including image- and video-based formats.
- The ability to interpret campaign data, identify performance trends and translate findings into practical improvements.
- Strong organisational skills and a methodical approach to campaign management and account structure.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present performance insights clearly.
- A proactive, commercially minded approach, with the confidence to take ownership and solve problems independently.

Desirable Experience
- Experience working within a digital marketing agency or performance marketing team.
- Exposure to regulated sectors such as legal services, financial services, insurance or claims.
- Experience managing higher-volume advertising budgets or campaigns across multiple verticals.
- Experience briefing creative teams, developing advertising assets and optimising visual campaigns against acquisition targets.

Benefits
- Private medical insurance.
- Medical cashback plan.
- Life assurance.
- Income protection insurance.
- Critical illness cover.

title: Social Media Executive
description:
Social Media Executive

Newly created role

Leading law firm

Hybrid working - Leeds, Manchester or Birmingham

My client is a well-established UK law firm with ambitious plans for continued growth. As part of this growth, the firm is investing in its brand and communications function, bringing teams more closely together and creating opportunities for people to contribute ideas, develop their expertise and have exposure to a broad range of work.

They are now looking for a Social Media Executive to join the communications team in a newly created role, taking ownership of the firm's corporate social media activity and helping to shape how this develops.

This is an opportunity to join at a point when the firm is properly establishing its social media capability. The successful candidate will look at how the firm can get greater value from its PR, thought leadership, campaigns, events and sponsorship activity, test different formats and approaches, explore opportunities across other platforms and use performance data to inform what happens next.

There is genuine scope to bring ideas. The team is open to experimentation and wants someone who is curious about new platforms and formats, can make considered recommendations and is comfortable testing what works. The role combines that creative freedom with the judgement needed to operate within a large corporate environment where brand, reputation and audience remain important.

Key responsibilities:
- Take day-to-day ownership of the firm's corporate social media activity, initially with a strong focus on LinkedIn.
- Develop the social content calendar and manage planning, scheduling, approvals, publishing and monitoring across relevant channels.
- Identify opportunities to increase the reach and impact of PR, thought leadership, campaigns, events, sponsorships and other firm content through social.
- Explore different content formats, platforms and approaches, bringing forward ideas supported by a clear rationale and understanding of the audience.
- Establish meaningful social media reporting and analytics, using performance data to identify what is working and make recommendations for future activity.
- Work closely with colleagues across communications, content, brand, multimedia, marketing operations and other teams to plan activity and maximise content across different channels.
- Monitor social conversations, platform developments, competitor activity and relevant trends, identifying opportunities and potential reputational considerations.
- Review the tools and technology available to support social media activity and contribute recommendations as the function develops.

About you:
- You are likely to have around 3 to 4 years' relevant experience and will have already gained hands-on experience managing corporate social media channels, ideally including strong exposure to LinkedIn. You should be able to demonstrate work you have delivered and explain the results or impact achieved.
- You will combine strong content judgement with an analytical approach. This means understanding social media metrics and reporting, interpreting what performance data is telling you and using that insight to make practical recommendations around content, formats, timing and channels.
- Creativity and curiosity are equally important. The team wants someone who will contribute ideas rather than wait to be told what to post, but who can balance that creativity with an understanding of brand, reputation and the requirements of a corporate audience.
- Legal or professional services experience is not essential. Experience gained within a corporate or B2 B environment would be useful, particularly where you have managed social activity across multiple stakeholders and built relationships internally to make things happen.

The opportunity:

This is a genuine development opportunity for someone who has built a strong grounding in social media and is ready for greater ownership. Rather than joining an established social function with fixed processes already in place, you will have the opportunity to help shape how the firm approaches social media, establish reporting and analytics, recommend tools and platforms and test new ways of maximising content. You will have access to wider creative and multimedia expertise and exposure to activity beyond traditional corporate content, including campaigns, events and sponsorships.

The wider business is growing, and there is potential for the remit to broaden as the firm's geographical footprint develops. The leadership approach is supportive of developing talent, giving people access to interesting work and creating room to experiment while providing appropriate guidance.

The role can be based in Birmingham, Manchester or Leeds, with occasional travel to London. The firm offers flexible hybrid working, although this opportunity will suit someone who values regular office-based collaboration and is comfortable spending around 3 days a week working with colleagues in person.

Equal Opportunities:

As a responsible business, it is important that we represent the diversity of our people, our clients and our communities. We believe that the firms that thrive are those with the most diverse team; that's why we work so hard to source the best talent from the broadest pool possible. As an equal opportunities employer we strive to accommodate anyone who may have specific needs. If you require reasonable adjustments to be made during the selection process, please talk to a member of the recruitment team so that any required adjustments can be made in advance.
